purpose: Real-data v4 baseline prepared before the frontend redesign so the UI can be evaluated against realistic production density rather than empty schemas or fake fixtures.
notes: This file is informational only and is not intended as a frontend dependency.
Production data lives in reports.json, critical-news.json, topic-intelligence.json, commerce-calendar.json and related datasets.
All populated baseline items are based on publicly verified sources available at generation time; unavailable facts are not invented.
